bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; sales and use; providing a refundable exemption for construction materials for construction of a city hall in the city of Columbia Heights.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+CITY OF COLUMBIA HEIGHTS; SALES TAX EXEMPTION FOR CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Exemption; refund.+]

[+(a) Materials and supplies used or consumed in and equipment incorporated into the construction, reconstruction, upgrade, expansion, renovation, or remodeling of a new city hall in the city of Columbia Heights are exempt from sales and use tax under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 297A, provided that the materials, supplies, and equipment are purchased after August 31, 2021, and before April 1, 2024. +]

[+(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.62, subdivisions 1 and 1a, applied, and then refunded in the same manner provided for projects under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.75, subdivision 1, clause (17). Refunds for eligible purchases must not be issued until after June 30, 2025. Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 289A.40, subdivision 1, applicants may file claims for refund under this section through December 31, 2025. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+The amount required to pay the refunds under subdivision 1 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective retroactively for sales and purchases made after August 31, 2021, and before April 1, 2024. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; sales and use; providing a refundable exemption for construction materials for construction of a city hall in the city of Columbia Heights.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. CITY OF COLUMBIA HEIGHTS; SALES TAX EXEMPTION FOR CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS.

Subdivision 1.

Exemption; refund.

(a) Materials and supplies used or consumed in and equipment incorporated into the construction, reconstruction, upgrade, expansion, renovation, or remodeling of a new city hall in the city of Columbia Heights are exempt from sales and use tax under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 297A, provided that the materials, supplies, and equipment are purchased after August 31, 2021, and before April 1, 2024.

(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.62, subdivisions 1 and 1a, applied, and then refunded in the same manner provided for projects under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.75, subdivision 1, clause (17). Refunds for eligible purchases must not be issued until after June 30, 2025. Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 289A.40, subdivision 1, applicants may file claims for refund under this section through December 31, 2025.

Subd. 2.

Appropriation.

The amount required to pay the refunds under subdivision 1 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective retroactively for sales and purchases made after August 31, 2021, and before April 1, 2024.
